author: HydrapheusZX
body:
Name: HydrapheusZX
Reason for ban: Banned for hacking not tolerated(NoSlowDown)
Reason to get unbanned: I have never hacked in my life, this claim is false and i would like to know what it means.
NoSlowDown??? I was just playing a game of nebula when while trying to kill the people getting the wool on map rendezvous II i believe it was while trying to rescue the pink wool i was suddenly banned, I was in shock as i had done nothing to deserve it. This is my first time getting banned and First time asking for an appeal. I don't have any evidence to support that i was not hacking but if it can be look up in a code or something(Idk how this stuff works) I'm sure we can figure something out.
                                                                                                                          Many Thanks                                                                                                                                                                                                         HydrapheusZX

title: HydrapheusZX ban appeal

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Hydrapheus,

I got a report of you hacking from another player, and indeed I thought it was true. While there are shifting glitches in Minecraft, I took some screenshots that depict you running while in a shifting position, and as well as that, logged out 3 times just in case it may have been a client glitch. Under consideration other players saw you, and I did as well even closing Minecraft and reopening it, typically the client glitch would reset, but it didn't.

Do you know an explanation to how this occured? I also didn't see any fences in the map you could click to perform it at that time. http://imgur.com/a/oilnS

I took the screenshots after I relogged.

replies.author: HydrapheusZX
replies.body:
Sir, I can assure you this is some kind of mistake, I see the evidence you have posted and I was not even aware of this happening, but i can guarantee that hacking or cheating of some sort was never my intent, this MUST be some kind of weird bug, I Have honestly never suffered this Glitch Once before, but i can safely assure you its just a weird bug. There is no reason you should believe me but I would appreciate it if I was unbanned from the server or just given a temp-ban for as long as you deem necessary( plz not forever).
                                                                                                                  Thank you

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Hydrapheus,

Since I have no video evidence of the ban, there's somehow a possibility that it was Minecraft, and the fact you are adamant of the hack never occurring, I will appeal you. Please take notice, however, that if you are caught hacking, you will be permanently banned.

Thank you for your patience.

Regards,
Kavinsky.
